# Third Party

Third-party integrations are not automatically compatible with or supported by NSPM. Their Nginx Proxy Manager references may require changes for the NSPM image and version scheme.

Known upstream-oriented integrations include:

- [HomeAssistant Hass.io plugin](https://github.com/hassio-addons/addon-nginx-proxy-manager)
- [UnRaid / Synology](https://github.com/jlesage/docker-nginx-proxy-manager)
- [Proxmox Scripts](https://github.com/ej52/proxmox-scripts/tree/main/apps/nginx-proxy-manager)
- [NPM Auth Gateway](https://github.com/Mark0025/npm-auth-gateway) — [details](/third-party/npm-auth-gateway)

To request an NSPM integration listing, open an [NSPM issue](https://github.com/creimer808/nginx-proxy-manager/issues/new?template=feature_request.md). Community integrations and upstream support channels are separate from NSPM support.
